#rom debug
#save after-first-dungeon
# DX learnsets (Gen 7): Scenario S1's Lv. 20 recruits know the last four moves their Gen 7 learnset teaches
# by then. Generated by tools/dxtest/gen_learnset_test.py.
# --- S1
# (power-on)
mash START sMainMenu 4 != 0 3000
wait 60
press UP
press A
wait 30
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press A
wait 30
expect *sMainMenu+4 4 == 53
wait 10
shot s01_pick
press A
mash A gDungeon 4 != 0 1800
wait 600
shot s01_in_dungeon
expect gDxScenario 1 == 1
expect *gDungeon+@gDxOffDungeonLocation 1 == 0
expect *gDungeon+@gDxOffDungeonFloor 1 == 1
# Wailord: WATER_GUN, WHIRLPOOL, ASTONISH, WATER_PULSE (Red's would be GROWL, SPLASH, WATER_GUN, WHIRLPOOL)
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!8+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoId 2 == 346
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!8+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 == 308
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!8+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!10 2 == 32
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!8+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!18 2 == 46
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!8+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!26 2 == 310
# Snorlax: DEFENSE_CURL, AMNESIA, LICK, YAWN (Red's would be AMNESIA, DEFENSE_CURL, BELLY_DRUM, HEADBUTT)
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!12+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoId 2 == 143
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!12+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 == 302
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!12+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!10 2 == 215
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!12+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!18 2 == 120
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!12+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!26 2 == 3
# Pikachu: THUNDERSHOCK, GROWL, QUICK_ATTACK, THUNDER_WAVE (Red's would be THUNDER_WAVE, QUICK_ATTACK, DOUBLE_TEAM, SLAM)
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!16+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoId 2 == 25
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!16+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 == 188
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!16+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!10 2 == 217
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!16+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!18 2 == 190
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!16+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!26 2 == 192
# Steelix: CURSE, ROCK_THROW, ROCK_TOMB, RAGE (Red's would be TACKLE, BIND, ROCK_THROW, HARDEN)
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!20+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoId 2 == 233
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!20+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 == 237
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!20+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!10 2 == 28
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!20+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!18 2 == 73
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon!20+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!26 2 == 19
